summary.text: Kevin Carpenter is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 63, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He defeated Betsy Coulter in the Democratic primary on May 12, 2026, and faces incumbent Republican Lori Cowger Dittman.

paragraphs.text: Carpenter previously ran for District 63 in 2022, advancing from the Democratic primary and losing the general election to Dittman, 71.1 percent to 28.9 percent.
